scope: M1 capability schema sets (implementation plan §6, §9). A set is a YANG library composition for compiling, validating and inventorying; it is not a claim that the platform supports the modules.
rules: Roots are the modules of the listed catalog families plus the listed modules whose decision (decisions.json) is runtime-baseline; imports are added from the source lock.
Every module in a set is implemented (one revision per module; an older revision pinned by an import is import-only) and every feature it declares is enabled, so the data node inventory is complete.
Modules named *-state that mirror an NMDA module (RFC 8342 non-NMDA compatibility) go only to nmda-state-compat, never into the set of the module they mirror.
The candidate variant of a set adds its families' candidate-upgrade modules; it is compiled and reported separately and never replaces the baseline.
